assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code PR-204.
CPT 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
The payer letter states the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
The clinical indication note documents a history of recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia.
Supraventricular tachycardia corresponds to diagnosis code I47.1.
The patient has episodes of dizziness.
Dizziness corresponds to diagnosis code R42.
The patient had a recent event of syncope.
Syncope corresponds to diagnosis code R55.
The 48-hour Holter monitor was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management.
The statement about the Holter monitor's purpose is contained in 'the order' (a referenced order document).
